chapter: Earl Hines, Chicago and later gigs
title: Touring in summers and jamming around Chicago
summary: The Grand Terrace closed in summers, so Young toured or played around Chicago with Albert Ammons, Guy Kelly and Israel Crosby.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: You -- did you spend most of your time with Earl's band at the Grand Terrace, or were there many tours?

No, we toured a lot. You see, the Grand Terrace would close in the summers. They would close. They didn't have -- there was no such thing as air conditioning around there. So, we toured in the summer, and some summers we didn't even work. We laid off most of the summers sometimes. We didn't do anything. That's when I played with a lot of bands around Chicago.

I used to play with different -- I got a chance to play a lot of different musicians around Chicago then at that particular time. That's how I come to know Albert Ammons and all them because I used to go and play with them around those kind of times, you know. And Guy Kelly was a nice trumpet player. He used to play with him. He's from New Orleans. He used to play with them, and so I got -- I had a chance to play with a lot of those guys.
Who all else did you play with?
Israel Crosby I played with. I played with -- of course, he played in that band. He was playing in that band. But I used to jam with him.
